instructions: You are working on the **Rural Hospital Economics Platform** (ruralpeds/Hospital-economics).
Stack: Julia 1.11, Genie/Stipple web framework, SearchLight ORM (PostgreSQL), JuMP/HiGHS optimisation, ABM/DES/MC simulation.
Two internal packages: packages/FinanceEngine (CFO analytics) and packages/RuralCore (auth, audit, config).
All tests run with: julia --compiled-modules=no --startup-file=no --project=. test/TESTFILE.jl
Build commands: make deps (install), make run (dev server on :8000), make test (full suite), make lint (Aqua.jl).
CSS uses CSS custom properties (var(--color-*), var(--space-*)) — never raw hex codes.
Use html_escape() from app/components/common.jl for all user strings interpolated into HTML.
Use _safe_href() from app/components/common.jl for href attributes to prevent javascript: URI injection.
New analytics modules follow the four-artifact rule: (1) src/ or packages/ function/struct, (2) Genie route + controller method, (3) Stipple reactive view in app/views/<name>/, (4) tests in test/.

P0 open gaps to address first: MIPS/VBP/HRRP/HACRP scoring (E-06), treasury 13-week cash model (A-09), service-line Markowitz portfolio (B-03), DEA efficiency frontier (C-01), board PDF packet generator (F-01), HCRIS CLI importer (F-06), real-options valuation (A-06), nonprofit WACC/MADS/synthetic-rating (A-04).
Full gap list and architecture spec: MBA_GAP_ANALYSIS_2026.md.

Julia packages in Project.toml are declared but some may not be installed in the current environment; use stdlib fallbacks (Statistics, Printf, Dates, Random, UUIDs) when external packages are unavailable.
MultiLevelPolicyCoupling.simulate_policy_coupling! requires enrollment as Float64, not Int.
